segments.text: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
Therefore said he unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
¶ And the seventy returned again with joy, saying,

segments.speaker: The seventy-two
segments.text: Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: The seventy-two
segments.text: I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

segments.speaker: The seventy-two
segments.text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

segments.speaker: The seventy-two
segments.text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
¶ In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
¶ And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
¶ And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying,

segments.speaker: An expert in the law
segments.text: Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
He said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: What is written in the law? how readest thou?
And he answering said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
And he said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus,

segments.speaker: Lawyer
segments.text: And who is my neighbour?
And Jesus answering said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

segments.speaker: The expert
segments.text: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him.
Then said Jesus unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Go, and do thou likewise.
¶ Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said,

segments.speaker: Martha
segments.text: Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
And Jesus answered and said unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
